Item 7.01 Regulation FD
On October 26, 2026, Vertiv Holdings Co., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”), issued a press release announcing the closing, by one of its wholly-owned subsidiaries, of the acquisition of King Environmental Services Ltd. (the “Acquisition”).
The press release announcing the closing of the Acquisition is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K.
The information set forth in Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, is being furnished and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that Section. The information in this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such a filing.
heads.EX-99.1:
Vertiv Completes Acquisition of King Environmental Services Ltd., Expanding Global Fluid Management Services
Acquisition expands Vertiv’s leadership in next-generation thermal services for high-density and AI-driven environments into Europe, Middle East and Africa
KES's fluid management, commissioning and load-testing expertise builds on Vertiv's North American capabilities established through its PurgeRite acquisition
COLUMBUS, Ohio (Oct. 26, 2026) — Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT), , a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced it has completed its acquisition of King Environmental Services Ltd. (KES), a Europe-based provider of fluid management, commissioning and load-testing services for high-density, liquid-cooled data centers.
The acquisition expands Vertiv's global thermal management services capabilities into Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and advances its strategy to support customers across the thermal chain. The transaction builds on Vertiv's established North American fluid management presence, including its 2025 acquisition of PurgeRite, and represents the next step in expanding its global thermal and fluid management services platform.
